question: Show Non-Small Cell Lung trials using PD1 where PD‑L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, ICI class, cancer type, and PD-L1 inclusion criteria for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) trials that used PD1 inhibitors and where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"ici_class\", \"cancer_type\", \"pdl1_inclusion\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'NSCLC' AND \"ici_class\" = 'PD1' AND \"pdl1_inclusion\" IS NOT NULL;","answer":"This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, ICI class, cancer type, and PD-L1 inclusion criteria for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) trials that used PD1 inhibitors and where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.","assumptions":""}
